scripts.start:dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "wait-on tcp:3001 && cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: concurrently "cd server && npm run build" "cd client && npm run build"
scripts.build:dev: npm run build && npm run start:dev
scripts.install: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -vrf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules dist client/dist server/dist build client/build server/build
scripts.deploy:prep: npm install && npm run build && npm run lint:all
scripts.invite: cd server && npm run build && node dist/scripts/createInvite.js
scripts.seed: node -e "console.error('Seed command retired: no server seed script is configured.'); process.exit(1)"
